// A rotation in space about an arbitrary center rather than the origin; the
// rotation axis passes through Center
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_(mathematics)).
type RotationAbout3D
    implements IValue, IRigid3D
{
    Rotation: Quaternion;
    Center: Point3D;
}
